items.question: In which structures should a wise builder construct this khalūrikā?
premises: A khalūrikā is the structure to be constructed.
The construction is prescribed as an injunction.
Temples and similar structures are the designated locations.
items.inference: Therefore, a wise builder should construct this khalūrikā in temples and similar structures.
uncertainties: The precise architectural form denoted by khalūrikā is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: A wise person should make this khalūrikā in temples and other such structures.
